name: 25C-NBOH
summary: A phenethylamine psychedelic and stimulant derivative of 2C-C, this compound is related and has similar effects to 25c-NBOMe. It is significantly more potent than 2C-C but less potent than 25c-NBOMe. Overdoses of NBOH compounds may cause dangerous vasoconstriction. The drug may induce uncomfortable body load.
advisory: Avoid: Other psychedelics, stimulants, and compulsive redosing

pharmacology.text: 25C-NBOH (2C-C-NBOH, NBOH-2CC) is a psychedelic drug and derivative of the phenethylamine derived hallucinogen 2C-C. It has similar serotonin receptor affinity to the better-known compound 25C-NBOMe.

uses.text: The drug has been encountered as a novel designer drug.

summaryZh: 25C-NBOH（化學名：2-(4-氯-2,5-二甲氧基苯基)-N-(2-羥基苄基)乙胺）是一種有機化合物，化學式為C17H20ClNO3。它是一種狡詐家藥物，曾被非法摻入吸液紙中並被巴西警方繳獲。
summaryZhHans: 25C-NBOH（化学名：2-(4-氯-2,5-二甲氧基苯基)-N-(2-羟基苄基)乙胺）是一种有机化合物，化学式为C17H20ClNO3。它是一种狡诈家药物，曾被非法掺入吸液纸中并被巴西警方缴获。
